edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of _safeMint(msg.sender, mintIndex) in mintDoges.
block.timestamp is compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide whether to lock startingIndexBlock.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP is initialized from block.timestamp inside the constructor.
mintDoges calls _safeMint, which performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient.
reserveDoges loops over _safeMint, invoking external receiver hooks for each minted token.
_safeMint calls back into the recipient (msg.sender) via onERC721Received before state finalization.
msg.sender is the callback target that receives control during _safeMint.
withdraw sends half of the contract balance to wallet1 via transfer.
withdraw sends the remaining balance to wallet2 via transfer.
setMintPrice is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender().
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting payout execution to the owner.
reserveDoges is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting free minting to the owner.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is guarded by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner in Ownable.
mintPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) is compared against msg.value, relying on SafeMath for overflow safety.
totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) is compared against MAX_DOGE_SUPPLY using SafeMath.add.
setStartingIndex writes the derived pseudo-random value into startingIndex.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to compute blockhash and elapsed blocks.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes block.number into startingIndexBlock.
constructor sets REVEAL_TIMESTAMP relative to block.timestamp.
constructor assigns the hardcoded wallet1 payout address.
constructor assigns the hardcoded wallet2 payout address.
constructor initializes mintPrice to 0.05 ETH.
constructor initializes maxToMint to 30.
withdraw reads wallet1 to determine the first transfer destination.
withdraw reads wallet2 to determine the second transfer destination.
numberOfTokens is bounded by maxToMint and combined with supply and price arithmetic in mintDoges.
_to is the recipient used by reserveDoges when minting reserved tokens.
_numberOfTokens drives the mint loop bound in reserveDoges.
_price is written into mintPrice by setMintPrice.
_maxValue is written into maxToMint by setMaxToMint.
baseURI is forwarded to _setBaseURI in setBaseURI.
_provenanceHash is written into PROVENANCE_HASH by setProvenanceHash.
newOwner becomes the contract owner in transferOwnership.
_revealTimeStamp is written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP by setRevealTimestamp.
walletBalance is the intermediate half-balance computed and spent inside withdraw.
setMintPrice writes the mintPrice state variable.
setMaxToMint writes the maxToMint state variable.
setRevealTimestamp overwrites the time-based REVEAL_TIMESTAMP state variable.
setProvenanceHash writes the PROVENANCE_HASH state variable.
setSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
mintDoges reads saleIsActive to gate public minting.

normalization_plan.reason: The numberOfTokens parameter only exists to bound and compute the mint loop inside mintDoges, so it collapses into that core function.
_to is the pure recipient argument of reserveDoges and carries no independent behavior.
_numberOfTokens only controls the mint loop bound in reserveDoges and merges into it.
_price is immediately assigned to the mintPrice state variable inside setMintPrice.
_maxValue is immediately assigned to the maxToMint state variable inside setMaxToMint.
baseURI is passed straight to _setBaseURI inside setBaseURI with no other use.
_provenanceHash is directly stored into PROVENANCE_HASH by setProvenanceHash.
newOwner is validated and stored as the owner only within transferOwnership.
_revealTimeStamp is written directly to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP inside setRevealTimestamp.
walletBalance is a temporary half-balance used only for the two transfers inside withdraw.
